Credit Note

This screen displays a credit note in its final format, ready for printing or sending to customers.

A credit note is a document issued to customers to acknowledge that they are owed money, typically due to returned goods, pricing errors, or other adjustments to their account.

Available Actions

Use the action buttons at the top of the screen to manage this credit note:

• Print - Generate a PDF version of the credit note for printing or saving

• Email - Send the credit note directly to the customer's email address

• Edit - Make changes to the credit note details, amounts, or line items

• Copy to - Create new transactions based on this credit note

Document Information

The credit note displays key information including the issue date, reference number, customer details, and billing address.

If the credit note is linked to a specific sales invoice, that invoice reference will be shown for easy tracking.

Line items show the products or services being credited, along with quantities, unit prices, and tax calculations.

To learn how to create or modify credit notes, see: Credit Note — Edit
